originalTitle: Why ADSK Stock Hands You So Much Cash Right Now
summary: The market is offering a hefty cash payout to own this software leader, but it comes with a story of major change and major risk.
content:
The market is offering a hefty cash payout to own this software leader, but it comes with a story of major change and major risk.

Shares of Autodesk (ADSK) , the software firm behind the tools used by architects and engineers, trade around $234.97, having fallen 23% over the last year while the S&P 500 climbed. Yet for every dollar an investor parks in the company today, Autodesk generates 5.4% in annual free cash . That compares to a 4.2% median for the S&P 500. The company doesn’t currently pay this out as a dividend; it retains the cash, but the yield still measures the underlying business’s cash-generating power relative to its price.

The market is offering a premium cash yield on a business it is simultaneously marking down. The question for an investor is simple: is this a bargain, or is the market right to be cautious?

How durable is the machine printing this cash?

Autodesk’s financial engine is built on a foundation of high profitability. The company’s GAAP operating margin over the last twelve months was 27%, far above the 18.4% median for an S&P 500 company. This isn’t a recent development; its three-year average GAAP operating margin is 24%, showing sustained pricing power and efficiency.

This profitability is paired with strong growth. Revenue grew 18.3% over the past year, more than double the market median of 7.8%. While the stock trades at a premium price-to-earnings multiple of 33.9, the cash generation and growth have been consistent. The discount here isn’t in the multiple; it’s in the cash yield the market is demanding for the execution risk ahead, on a business that otherwise looks like quality at a premium price.

So why is the market worried about the largest deal Autodesk’s ever done?

The generous cash offer exists because the market is pricing in significant execution risk. Autodesk is currently navigating two major initiatives at once. First, it is integrating MaintainX, a maintenance and operations software company, in what management calls “the largest deal we’ve ever done.” This acquisition is designed to expand Autodesk into a new market and strengthen its capabilities by adding rich operational data.

At the same time, the company is in the middle of a major sales reorganization. This internal shift is already causing disruption, according to one sell-side analyst who cited channel checks describing “a degree of disruption” from partners. Management acknowledges the change has resulted in the “weak new performance we expected,” suggesting a near-term hit to new business is part of the plan. The market’s concern is that layering a large acquisition on top of this internal disruption is simply too much to handle at once. The question of what could push the stock higher from here hinges on the company’s ability to navigate these dual challenges successfully.

What number proves the playbook is working?

Despite the risks, management is signaling confidence. The company recently delivered strong quarterly results and raised its full-year guidance. It now expects revenue in a range of $8.15 billion to $8.21 billion and a non-GAAP operating margin of approximately 39%. For investors who prefer a broad software ETF to a single stock, certain funds offer exposure to the sector.

Ultimately, the debate settles on one metric: cash. Management has explicitly baked the disruption from its sales plan into its forecast. The single number that will test whether the strategy is working is the company’s full-year free cash flow guidance, which was raised to a range of $2.73 billion to $2.80 billion. Hitting this target would signal that the integration and reorganization are under control, making today’s cash yield look like a clear opportunity. Falling short would validate the market’s current caution.

Like The Cash Generation? Own The Discipline Behind It

High cash yields are the market’s most honest offer, and also its most loaded one: some are bargains, some are warnings, and telling them apart name by name is real work that never ends.

chineseTitle: 为什么 ADSK 股票现在会给你这么多现金
chineseSummary: 市场为拥有这家软件领导者提供了巨额现金支付，但它也伴随着重大变化和重大风险的故事。
chineseContent:
市场为拥有这家软件领导者提供了巨额现金支付，但它也伴随着重大变化和重大风险的故事。

为建筑师和工程师提供工具的软件公司 Autodesk (ADSK) 的股价在 234.97 美元左右，去年下跌了 23%，而标准普尔 500 指数却在上涨。然而，如今投资者在公司投入的每一美元，欧特克每年都会产生 5.4% 的自由现金。相比之下，标准普尔 500 指数的中位数为 4.2%。该公司目前不将其作为股息支付；它保留了现金，但收益率仍然衡量基础业务相对于其价格的现金产生能力。

市场正在为其同时降价的业务提供溢价现金收益率。投资者面临的问题很简单：这是便宜货，还是市场应该保持谨慎？

印钞机的耐用性如何？

Autodesk 的金融引擎建立在高盈利能力的基础上。该公司过去 12 个月的 GAAP 营业利润率为 27%，远高于标准普尔 500 指数公司 18.4% 的中位数。这不是最近的事态发展；其三年平均 GAAP 营业利润率为 24%，显示出持续的定价能力和效率。

这种盈利能力与强劲的增长相伴。过去一年收入增长 18.3%，是市场中值 7.8% 的两倍多。虽然该股的市盈率高达 33.9 倍，但现金生成和增长一直保持稳定。这里的折扣不是倍数，而是倍数。这是市场对未来执行风险所要求的现金收益率，而这项业务原本看起来质量很高，但价格却很高。

那么，为什么市场对欧特克有史以来最大的一笔交易感到担忧呢？

慷慨的现金报价之所以存在，是因为市场定价了重大的执行风险。 Autodesk 目前正在同时实施两项重大举措。首先，它正在整合维护和运营软件公司MaintainX，管理层称之为“我们做过的最大的交易”。此次收购旨在将 Autodesk 扩展到新市场，并通过添加丰富的运营数据来增强其能力。

与此同时，该公司正在进行重大的销售重组。一位卖方分析师表示，这种内部转变已经造成了干扰，他引用渠道检查描述了合作伙伴的“一定程度的干扰”。管理层承认这一变化导致了“我们预期的新业绩疲弱”，这表明近期对新业务的打击是该计划的一部分。市场担心的是，在这种内部混乱的基础上进行大规模收购实在是难以立即应对。什么可以推高股价，取决于该公司成功应对这些双重挑战的能力。

什么数字可以证明该剧本正在发挥作用？

尽管存在风险，但管理层仍表现出信心。该公司最近公布了强劲的季度业绩，并上调了全年指引。目前预计收入在 81.5 亿美元至 82.1 亿美元之间，非 GAAP 营业利润率约为 39%。对于更喜欢广泛的软件 ETF 而不是单一股票的投资者来说，某些基金提供对该行业的投资。

最终，争论集中在一个指标上：现金。管理层已明确将销售计划的干扰纳入其预测中。测试该战略是否有效的唯一数字是该公司的全年自由现金流指引，该指引已上调至 27.3 亿美元至 28 亿美元的范围。达到这一目标将标志着整合和重组已得到控制，使今天的现金收益率看起来像是一个明显的机会。若达不到预期，将证实市场目前的谨慎态度。

对于市场已下跌而现金持续流动的更多股票，我们的逢低买入屏幕每天都会显示它们。

喜欢现金一代吗？拥有背后的纪律

高现金收益率是市场最诚实的报价，也是最有分量的报价：有些是便宜货，有些是警告，逐个区分它们是永无休止的真正工作。
